messages:
Sam: Hey team — presales thread for AcmeAI POC. Customer wants a 6-week onramp: demo -> 2-week staging -> 2-week soak -> final evaluation. Key asks: throughput for 800 concurrent users (chat), 99th pct latency target ~500ms, and a budget not to exceed $7k/mo for the POC. Can we validate feasibility and produce a short capacity + cost sketch?
Elaine: quick clarifying Qs: what does "800 concurrent users" mean in rps? are they expecting sustained typing (streaming) or bursty single-request flows? also need the prompt/avg token sizes for estimates.
Rachel (Customer): Mostly chat-style sessions. Avg message in = 40 tokens, model reply avg = 220 tokens. Active typing means ~0.2 reqs/sec per active user average. Peak concurrency expected early afternoon — maybe 300 active simultaneously.
Sam: ok so rough math: 300 active * 0.2 rps = 60 rps sustained peak. Avg tokens per request = 260 (in+out). Daily traffic: 60 rps * 86,400s = 5,184,000 tokens/day. Monthly ~155M tokens. Budget cap $7k/month — need to map to per-token pricing or Dedicated cost.
Elaine: for a hosted POC using Redwood hosted models, rough hosted cost example (estimate only): if hosted rate were $0.08 per 1k tokens -> 155M tokens = 155,000 * $0.08 = $12,400/mo. Over budget. Two levers: reduce tokens (prompt engineering, system messages, summarization), or Dedicated with reserved GPU which can be cheaper for heavy token volume.
Mike: infra thoughts — for 60 rps with streaming and 220-token responses avg, a single A10G/A100 node (depending on model) with batching and continuous KV cache should handle this with p95 < 500ms if we pick a mid-sized model quantized. If they want strict 99th <500ms and conservative headroom, target 2 x A100 with autoscale + burst policy to cover peaks.
Sam: can you put numbers for GPU-backed monthly cost vs hosted token cost? customer wants a clear compare.
Mike: ballpark compute-only cost (cloud GPU rent + infra): 2x A100 (on-demand) ~ $6.5k-$9k/mo depending on region. + orchestration/networking ~ $0.5k. So ~7k-10k/mo. With reserved/dedicated commit we can push to ~$5k/mo. But that excludes Redwood Dedicated licensing/ops fees; for a short POC we can do a time-limited Dedicated trial (ask sales) or run on customer's VPC/private infra.
Rachel (Customer): If we did summarization on the client (send concat of last 8 messages summarized to ~60 tokens) — how much does that reduce cost?
Elaine: quick calc: if we can cut avg output tokens from 220 -> 120 and input from 40 -> 30 (with summarization), avg total ~150 tokens. That reduces monthly tokens from 155M -> ~90M. Hosted cost at $0.08/1k -> 90,000 * $0.08 = $7,200/mo. Still slightly above target but much closer.
Sam: ok good. Also list success criteria we should propose to AcmeAI for go/no-go at the end of POC. My draft: 1) Functional: the assistant answers 10 representative prompts with >= 85% accuracy per eval set; 2) Performance: p95 latency <= 500ms at peak traffic (60 rps sustained, bursts to 120 rps); 3) Cost: projected monthly inference cost <= $7k under production traffic profile (with recommended optimizations); 4) Reliability: no more than 1% error rate and transparent fallback behavior. Thoughts?
Mike: add: ops criteria — ability to roll back model versions, and KV/prefix caching reduces duplicate tokens by >=20% for their workload. Also specify monitoring hooks: per-request token breakdown + per-model latency histograms.
Susan (Security): security checklist items for the customer: VPC peering or Private deployment for sensitive data, KMS integration for keys, SOC2/AICPA evidence request timeline. Also need to know if they will require an on-prem image or if VPC-hosted Dedicated is fine. We should push their security questionnaire now — it can add 2-3 business days.
Rachel (Customer): They will need KMS and will want the logs retained for 90 days. Also they have a short legal window, so security answers fast please.
Sam: actionable next steps: 1) Elaine + Mike: produce a 1-page capacity sketch (GPU config options: single A10G w/ batching, 2x A100 redundant) + two cost scenarios (hosted token estimate w/ current prompt vs optimized prompts, and Dedicated estimate with reserved pricing). 2) Susan: start security Q and confirm whether VPC or on-prem required. 3) Sam: I'll propose the draft success criteria to the customer and negotiate the budget/timebox. Target: deliver internal doc by EOD tomorrow.
presales-bot: Reminder — please attach PO/contract checklist if we want Dedicated trial.
Elaine: I'll also include a short prompt-reduction plan: system turns on summarization after N messages, compress instructions, and send only delta for embeddings/rerank flows. I'll include an example prompt transformation.
Mike: I'll add an estimation table and simple ops playbook: canary rollout (10% traffic -> 50% -> 100%), fallback to smaller model on overload, and automatic auto-scale rules (CPU mem + queue latency).
Susan: I'll queue the security questionnaire answers and ping Legal for the licensing term for a short POC.
Rachel (Customer): thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround. Can we get the EOD doc and a timeboxed 30-min sync tomorrow to review?
Sam: yes — scheduled 30-min sync tomorrow 10:30am PT. I'll drop calendar invite. :thumbsup:
